• CODEC: H.264 (Compatible), H.265 (Efficient), AV1 (Next-Gen quality).

• ORIENTATION: Lock video to Auto, Portrait, or Landscape aspect ratios.

• RESOLUTION: NATIVE uses screen size; 4K/2K/FHD set exact pixel dimensions.

• FRAME RATE: 24-60 (Standard), 90-120 (Ultra smooth for gaming).

• BITRATE: Higher Mbps means sharper details but larger file sizes.

• BITRATE MODE: VBR saves space; CBR maintains constant high quality.

• AUDIO SOURCE: Silence, Microphone, System Internal, or MIX (Sys+Mic).

• AUDIO QUALITY: Adjust sample rate and bitrate for audio fidelity.
I-H.264 (Ihambisana kakhulu nabanye abadlali), i-H.265 (Ukuminyanisa okusebenza kahle kakhulu), noma i-AV1 (Ikhwalithi ephezulu yesizukulwane esilandelayo).
Khiya izilinganiso zokubukeka kwevidiyo erekhodiwe ukuze kube Okuzenzakalelayo, Ukuma ngobude (okuqondile), noma Ukwakheka kwezwe (okuvundlile).
I-NATIVE ithwebula ngokulungiswa okunembile kwesikrini sakho. I-4K, 2K, FHD, HD, kanye nokuthwebula ukhiye we-SD kuya kubukhulu obujwayelekile.
Ibanga elingu-24-60 FPS lokushelela kwevidiyo okujwayelekile. Amadivayisi anesilinganiso sokuvuselela esiphezulu asekela i-90-120 FPS ukuze adlale amageyimu abushelelezi.
Icacisa isivinini sedatha ku-Mbps. Amanani aphezulu athwebula imininingwane ebukhali ngesikhathi sokunyakaza kodwa aphumela kumafayela evidiyo amakhulu.
I-VBR (I-Bitrate Eguquguqukayo) ikala ngokushintshashintshayo izinga ledatha ukuze ulondoloze isitoreji. I-CBR (I-Bitrate Eqhubekayo) iphoqa imininingwane ephezulu ngokunganaki ukunyakaza.
Khetha kokuthi Ukuthula (KUVALIWE), Imakrofoni (MIC), I-System Internal Loopback (SYS), noma i-MIX (SYS+MIC) ukuze urekhode kokubili ndawonye.
Lungisa izinga lesampula lomsindo kanye ne-bitrate yombhalo wekhodi. Izigaba eziphakeme zinikeza imininingwane ehlanzekile, engenamsindo.

I-Auto Orientation iyi-gimmick futhi izokwehlisa ikhwalithi yakho yokurekhoda.

I-Android izungezisa isibonisi esibonakalayo phakathi nokurekhoda, ngokuvamile okubangela ukungqubuzana kokulungiswa, amabha amnyama, nokungaqini kwe-encoder.

Sincoma ngokuqinile ukukhetha ngokuma ngobude noma i-Landscape ukuze ifane nomumo oyinhloko wohlelo lokusebenza ohlose ukurekhoda okungcono kakhulu, lokhu kukhiqiza kakhulu - lokhu kukhiqiza kakhulu.
Ukuze ubonise ibhamuza lesilawuli esintantayo, i-RecorderX idinga imvume yokubonisa phezu kwezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza. Sicela unikeze esikrinini esilandelayo.

Umbhalo wekhodi we-Hardware AV1 awusekelwe kule divayisi.\n\nUkurekhoda kuzokwenziwa kusetshenziswa i-Software AV1 (CPU encoding). Lokhu kungase kubangele ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwe-CPU, ukusetshenziswa kwebhethri okuphezulu, kanye nohlaka olunamandla lwehla ekulungisweni okuphezulu.

Thayipha isiqalo osithandayo ebhokisini lesifanekiso ukuze wenze ngezifiso izihloko zevidiyo zakho ezilondoloziwe.
Engeza isimeli se-{timestamp} ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ifayela ngalinye lihlelwa ngokulandelana ngedethi.
Izinhlamvu ezingavumelekile zihlutshulwa ngokuzenzekelayo, okuzenzakalelayo kube isitembu sesikhathi esihlanzekile uma singenalutho.
Fometha: yyyyMMdd_Hmms. 20260712_143000).
Swayiphela kwesokunxele noma kwesokudla noma yikuphi endaweni yesihloko se-RecorderX ukuze ujikeleze phakathi kwemibala ye-accent yetimu engu-12 emihle!
Thinta ukuze ubuke okuqoshiwe kwakho ku-/Movies/RecorderX
Ukurekhoda kuhlulekile. Thinta ukuze uqale kabusha ngezilungiselelo eziphephile.
Alukho uhlelo lokusebenza lwesidlali sevidiyo olutholiwe
Sicela unike amandla imvume Yokufinyeleleka ye-RecorderX ukuze ulawule umakrofoni
Sicela unike amandla imvume Yokufinyeleleka ye-RecorderX ukuze uthwebule isikrini
I-Hardware AV1 ayitholakali. Kurekhodwa kumodi ye-Software AV1…
I-%1$s ayinayo i-encoder yehadiwe lapha, kurekhodwa ku-%2$s esikhundleni salokho.
I-hardware igcwele kakhulu. Yehlisa ikhwalithi ngokuzenzakalela…
Isetshenziselwa kuphela ukuthwebula izithombe-skrini zesistimu yomdabu ngesikhathi samaseshini wokurekhoda isikrini ngaphandle kokuphazamisa ividiyo.
Bamba imizuzwana engu-2 kusithonjana sekhamera ebhamuzeni ukuze uthole izilungiselelo zekhamera (shintsha ngaphambili/emuva, shintsha usayizi, isimo sombuthano/unxande).
Kwengezwe amawijethi we-1×1 Ukurekhoda Okusheshayo & 1×2 Isikhungo Sokulawula anezilawuli zomsindo bukhoma, ikhamera, kanye nokuqondisa.
Ibhokisi lengxoxo elihlukanisiwe lokuthwebula isikrini, isimo sekhamera ebukhoma esivumelanisiwe, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kokuzinza.
